description: Procedural Fortran subroutines with COMMON blocks and ISAM-style I/O callouts. Targets engineering / process control codebases (Kiwiplan-class, scientific solvers in MINPACK style, paper mill / wet-end controllers).

claimKinds.label: Invariant
claimKinds.description: Behavioural invariants the subroutine must preserve across all valid inputs.

fields.name: generatorHints
fields.doc: Optional. Per-claim Hypothesis-style generator hints (per ADR-030). Shape: { inputs:[{name,type,min?,max?,maxLen?,alphabet?}], constraint?:string, examples?:[{...}] }. When present, the 4th validation gate (FALSIFYING) exercises the claim against generated inputs; when absent, the gate skips the claim with skipReason: no_hints.

claimKinds.label: Side effect
claimKinds.description: Externally-visible state mutations: ISAM rewrites, event emissions, COMMON-block updates.

claimKinds.label: Edge case
claimKinds.description: Boundary and failure-mode conditions the subroutine handles (or is silent about).

fields.name: generatorHints
fields.doc: Optional. Per-claim Hypothesis-style generator hints (per ADR-030). Same shape as on invariant. When present, the 4th gate exercises this edge case against generated inputs that satisfy the hint constraint; when absent, the gate skips the claim with skipReason: no_hints.

claimKinds.label: Open question
claimKinds.description: Ambiguities the source does not resolve and the SME must answer before sign-off.

promptHints.emphasis: Cite line ranges aggressively; legacy F77 logic depends on column positions and ordering. Prefer 'high' confidence only when the source is fully explicit; downgrade when behaviour depends on uninitialised COMMON state.
